<section class="c-slab c-slab--white">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-split">
      <div class="c-prose">
        <h2>What we bring</h2>
        <p>
          Computational capacity and method, delivered as a genuine research
          contribution rather than a service. In practice that means one of the
          following.
        </p>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>Multi-omics and transcriptomic analysis</strong> for groups with sequencing data and no bioinformatics support.</li>
          <li><strong>Epidemiological and survey analysis</strong>, including systematic review and meta-analysis, to a reporting standard suitable for publication.</li>
          <li><strong>Predictive modelling</strong> on clinical or imaging data, with external validation and interpretability built in.</li>
          <li><strong>Spatial analysis</strong> — disease mapping, accessibility modelling, remote-sensing covariates.</li>
          <li><strong>Grant support</strong>, contributing the analysis plan and computational methodology to a joint proposal.</li>
        </ul>

        <h2>What we ask</h2>
        <p>
          Authorship for the students who do the work, and permission to publish
          the analysis code once the paper is out. Where data cannot be shared, the
          code still can.
        </p>

        <h2>Starting a collaboration</h2>
        <p>
          Write to us with the question, the data you hold, and the timeline. If it
          is a fit we will propose a small first piece of work rather than a full
          agreement — it is a better test for both sides.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="c-aside">
        <dl class="c-facts">
          <dt>Contact</dt>
          <dd><a href="mailto:training.chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Research%20collaboration%20enquiry">training.chiralbd@gmail.com</a></dd>

          <dt>Typical first step</dt>
          <dd>A scoped pilot analysis, two to three months.</dd>

          <dt>We can host</dt>
          <dd>Joint student projects, co-supervised theses, and shared training workshops.</dd>

          <dt>We cannot</dt>
          <dd>Take paid contract work — the centre is volunteer-run and non-profit.</dd>
        </dl>

        <p style="margin-top:1.5rem">
          <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="mailto:training.chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Research%20collaboration%20enquiry">Propose a collaboration</a>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
